ledger.x: 1961: Cliopatria continues British Africa as the remaining British colonies.
10 December 1963: the British protectorate over Zanzibar ends and the Sultan rules a sovereign state.
6 July 1964: Nyasaland becomes independent as Malawi.
24 October 1964: Northern Rhodesia becomes independent as Zambia.
11 November 1965: Southern Rhodesia declares independence unilaterally.
30 September 1966: Bechuanaland becomes independent as Botswana.
4 October 1966: Basutoland becomes independent as Lesotho.
29 June 1976: with the Seychelles, the last of Britain's remaining African colonies in this set becomes independent.
